_comment: E2E shot plan template (framework v2). Games AUTHOR their own copy at <game>/e2e_shots.json. run-e2e-review.sh selects groups by PR diff (group.match regexes), resolves them into a flat plan, and runs e2e_capture.gd. Example below is mini-pong (game loop archetype). Shot-level "deadline_s" (seconds) overrides max_wall_seconds for that shot only; absent → falls back to the global max_wall_seconds (backward compatible, #372).

loop._comment: Default archetype: one full game loop storyboard. Active unless a more specific group matches.

visual_pause._comment: PR touching pause overlay: inject Escape, capture PAUSED, unpause.

content._comment: Content archetype (narrative games): journey/walkthrough. Placeholder — populated per game at C5.5 assembly.

journey._comment: Journey archetype (narrative games): full playthrough + transcript + state trajectory. Populated per game.
